description: Human-verified labels for the pipeline-batch fixtures. Used by scripts/runDetectionBenchmark.mjs to score glasses and headwear detection. Labels were assigned by visual inspection of each image.

fields.glasses: true when any eyeglasses or sunglasses are worn on the face
fields.hat: true when a hat, cap, beanie, or other non-religious headwear is worn
fields.headCovering: true when a religious or medical head covering is worn
fields.skinTone: coarse light | medium | dark grouping, for per-group metrics only
